publication issues.summary: Actual paired report records 11 unresolved render cells, 11 wire glyph differences, 9 uncertainties, 0 format questions. AP411 private partial reconstruction. Baseline conversion exits 2 blocked BC.inputAW; five logical target references associated to existing BC inputs via distinct owned routes. AW/BA endpoints are one column before input points; native 6/L leads show gaps and faint crossings. No physical pin identity, new wire or electrical join inferred. Exact raw inverse and byte-identical TXT checked. Candidate conversion exits 0 with 11 unresolved differences, all classified wire glyphs: ten control-label placement cells and one junction at [67,27]. Printed P.No 258454 plus replacement glyph remains unresolved due scan damage. Native overview, selected native tiles, flagged regions and first junction panel viewed. All 29 junction/52 crossing panels were generated but not all individually reviewed, and global registration is untrusted: block fit 12/60 inliers median 2.21 render pixels; independent edge only 4/17 scored with one right-side inlier, median 0.73; nine-point maximum disagreement 322.96 pixels. Red-blue comparisons visibly badly aligned and cannot establish point agreement. 100 routes/196 segments map to 25 sections, no complete end-to-end electrical or omission proof. Candidate unapproved; no canonical source, key or publication changed. Current selected json differs from candidate review source; historical mismatch retained. The candidate source does not fully match the previous local selection: model match False, text match True. The previous selection is preserved in the publication receipt.
